title: pit-multisource: point-in-time construction of a multisource dataset and reproduction of the article's results
description: Python package that rebuilds the point-in-time multisource dataset of Binance BTC/ETH bars, GDELT GKG news metadata and US release calendars from its sources, and reproduces the numbers of the article "Point-in-Time Consistency for Multisource Time-Series Data: A Formal Model and Construction Method for Evolving News Metadata" (Journal of Big Data) from the released dataset. Every released table except the raw GKG records, the slot ledger and `news/gdelt_slots.parquet` is rebuilt from sources and compared row for row; GDELT selection is checked on a 30-slot sample of the original archives; the news and entity builds start from the released raw GKG records and the source-domain build from the released news records.
